noncomputable def firstIsoHom (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    M ⧸ LinearMap.ker f →ₗ[R] LinearMap.range f :=
  (LinearMap.ker f).liftQ (f.codRestrict (LinearMap.range f) fun x => ⟨x, rfl⟩)
    (le_of_eq (by ext x; simp [LinearMap.mem_ker]))

  refine fun x hx => Submodule.Quotient.induction_on (LinearMap.ker f) x fun m => ?_
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, firstIsoHom_mk] at hx

narration: 第三轮：换构造。不再「liftQ 到 N 再 codRestrict 回 im f 并证核相等」，而是「liftQ 到 N，再在最外层 codRestrict 到 im f，用 Quotient.induction_on 给出 ∈ range f 的证明」——这样核等式整步消失，只剩一条陪集上的取值等式（liftQ_apply）。同时 firstIsoHom_mk 改用 Subtype.ext。

attempt_code:
noncomputable def firstIsoHom (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    M ⧸ LinearMap.ker f →ₗ[R] LinearMap.range f :=
  LinearMap.codRestrict (LinearMap.range f) ((LinearMap.ker f).liftQ f le_rfl)
    (fun x => Submodule.Quotient.induction_on (LinearMap.ker f) x fun m =>
      ⟨m, (Submodule.liftQ_apply (LinearMap.ker f) f m).symm⟩)

theorem firstIsoHom_mk (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (x : M) :
    firstIsoHom f (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = ⟨f x, ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩ :=
  Subtype.ext (Submodule.liftQ_apply (LinearMap.ker f) f x)
